notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's ability to add {G}.
Untap Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's ability, giving it a -1/-1 counter.
Tap Necrotic Ooze and remove a -1/-1 counter use Channeler Initiate's ability to add {1} of any color.
Repeat for infinite mana.
